owner_calls.title: Thor
owner_calls.question: Both serve on Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D. team guarding Mjolnir's crater base: Sitwell runs the lab and warns Coulson of Thor's breach, after which Coulson calls Clint up to the catwalk. They never speak to each other. Does serving the same leader in the same operation earn a stage here?
options: None: same operation, no exchange between them

Add ally stage at Thor: 'Clint and Jasper Sitwell both serve on Coulson's team guarding the hammer's crater. When Sitwell warns Coulson of an intruder, Coulson sends Clint up to cover him.' Cards: a->b 'A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent on Coulson's team at the crater.' b->a 'A S.H.I.E.L.D. archer on Coulson's team at the crater.'
owner_calls.evidence: Thor: Sitwell heads the lab studying the hammer, warns Coulson of the breach, and Coulson calls Barton for assistance; no line between Sitwell and Barton.
